subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “He had to walk around machines, mud, and parked scooters.”?
options: A new fan arrived two weeks later.
His later reports were cleaner, but sometimes less bold.
Sometimes he arrived later than before.
Five minutes later, the violin player arrived.
